text:
maria: FYI seeing repeated 95/99th tail spikes on eu-west GPU nodes since ~03:10; looks like KV cache regen + sudden PCIe queuing. latency jumps ~120-300ms. anyone else seeing this?

oleg: saw that too, digging into node-level metrics now. which pools affected — shared or dedicated?

maria: mostly shared-slices in rack-r12 but a few dedicated slices show the same tail. stacktrace-ish from agent logs: `kvcache regen triggered -> stall -> burst of small allocations`. dashboard: https://graf.redwood/eu-west/gpu-latency?range=1h

shaun: interesting — pattern matches a noisy-tenant that triggers regen, then other tenants suffer due to eviction storms. could be a workload with heavy prompt-switching.

anya: FYI rolled allocator tweak yesterday (commit 7f4c2d) that changes prefer-warm-slot heuristics. might have increased churn for some slab sizes. rolling back is option but risky during peak.

kevin: @maria can you confirm tenant ids affected? if we can quarantine the tenant to a soft-dedicated slice we can stop the cascade. tradeoff: reserved cost vs immediate SLO.

maria: affected tenants: T-449, T-784, T-1012 (T-1012 is highest churn). agree on soft-quarantine. curious about non-disruptive fallback routing tho.

sre-bot: [ALERT] node-r12-03 high gpu_tail_latency 2026-03-23T03:12:10Z -> routing_policy=default -> actions_suggested=[soft_quarantine, fallback_to_preemptible]

oleg: proposal: apply a soft-quarantine policy that steers new allocs from T-1012 into a fractional dedicated slice for 30m and enable fallback routing for other tenants to preemptible shelf. low friction and reversible.

kevin: I can run the quarantine canary now. command we use:```/infra quarantine --tenant T-1012 --mode soft --duration 30m --slice-type fractional-dedicated```will also push a route override for other tenants:```routing.override.add --match 'tenant!=T-1012' --target preemptible-shelf --weight 0.2```

shaun: sounds good. also add a short-circuit to disable the prefer-warm-slot heuristic for the affected racks:```kubectl -n infra set env allocator CONFIG_OVERRIDES='{"prefer_warm_slot":false, "kv_regen_backoff_ms":3000}' --context eu-west```

anya: we should also tag this for postmortem and add a regression test to eval harness for KV-heavy prompt sequences. if commit 7f4c2d is causal we should create a revert MR and test in canary cluster.

maria: running canary now. repeating steps in #runbook. will report back in 5m. thanks everyone :thumbsup:

kevin: canary executed, quarantine active. monitoring dashboards look better already (95th dropped ~80ms). leaving fallback routing live.

maria: confirmed tail improving, will keep quarantine for 30m then reassess. adding postmortem stub and assigning to allocator+infra teams.

oleg: note on cost — fractional dedicated for 30m ~ $12 incremental in eu-west; worth it for SLO protection. adding to incident cost log.

anya: opening revert MR for 7f4c2d and starting a canary rollout plan that includes KV-regen synthetic load.

maria: closing this thread once 30m done, but keeping monitor alerts in place. thanks all.
